title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #12

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is a pillar (rukn) of swalah? (1 mark)
   A. A type of clothing
   B. A part that must be done for the prayer to be valid
   C. A place
   D. A drink

2. What is the meaning of generosity? (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to share
   B. Keeping everything
   C. Giving freely without expecting anything back
   D. Boasting

3. Which is a good way to say sorry to a parent? (1 mark)
   A. Blame
   B. Say sorry politely and try to improve
   C. Shout
   D. Refuse

4. What is the awrah? (1 mark)
   A. The parts of the body that must be covered
   B. A fast
   C. A cap
   D. A prayer

5. "Maliki yawmid-din" means (1 mark)
   A. The Most Kind
   B. Guide us to the path
   C. Master of the Day of Judgement
   D. Lord of all the worlds

6. Which surah is number 112 in the Qur'an? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Masad
   B. An-Nasr
   C. Al-Ikhlas
   D. Al-Falaq

7. Whose protection did the Prophet enter Makkah under after Taif? (1 mark)
   A. Waraqa
   B. Mut'im ibn Adiy
   C. Abu Bakr
   D. Khalid

8. In which surah does Allah praise the Prophet's great character? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Masad
   B. Al-Ikhlas
   C. Al-Qalam (68:4)
   D. An-Nasr

9. Which of these can help find prayer times? (1 mark)
   A. Counting stars only
   B. Asking a stranger to guess
   C. A mosque timetable or the adhan
   D. Guessing from the weather only

10. Which angel will blow the Trumpet? (1 mark)
   A. Israfil
   B. Atid
   C. Jibril
   D. Mikail

11. Which animal is often used to pull ploughs on farms? (1 mark)
   A. Giraffe
   B. Ox
   C. Lion
   D. Zebra

12. What is silat ar-rahm? (1 mark)
   A. Fasting
   B. Praying
   C. Keeping family ties
   D. Trading

13. What should you do after cleaning a najasa? (1 mark)
   A. Eat immediately
   B. Wash your hands
   C. Sleep
   D. Ignore

14. Who was the brother who helped Prophet Musa? (1 mark)
   A. Yahya
   B. Idris
   C. Ilyas
   D. Harun

15. What does the Kaaba represent? (1 mark)
   A. A palace
   B. A market
   C. A school
   D. The House built to worship Allah alone

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Describe what a siwak is and how it is used. (3 marks)

17. Explain how brushing teeth can be an act of ibadah. (4 marks)

18. What does it mean that children are an amanah? (2 marks)

19. State four conditions of swalah. (4 marks)

20. What is an attribute of Allah? Give one example. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — A part that must be done for the prayer to be valid
   Leaving a pillar spoils the prayer.

2. C — Giving freely without expecting anything back
   Generous people give willingly.

3. B — Say sorry politely and try to improve
   Apologise.

4. A — The parts of the body that must be covered
   Awrah is what must be covered.

5. C — Master of the Day of Judgement
   It is the fourth verse of Al-Fatiha.

6. C — Al-Ikhlas
   Al-Ikhlas is surah 112, Al-Falaq 113 and An-Naas 114.

7. B — Mut'im ibn Adiy
   Traditional accounts mention Mut'im.

8. C — Al-Qalam (68:4)
   Surah Al-Qalam 68:4 speaks about his great standard of character.

9. C — A mosque timetable or the adhan
   These are reliable.

10. A — Israfil
   Israfil blows the Trumpet by Allah's command.

11. B — Ox
   Oxen pull ploughs and carts.

12. C — Keeping family ties
   Ties of kinship.

13. B — Wash your hands
   Wash hands with soap and water.

14. D — Harun
   Harun was Musa's brother and helper.

15. D — The House built to worship Allah alone
   Ibrahim and Ismail built it.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: It is a small stick from a tree such as the arak. One end is chewed to make fibres, and it is rubbed on the teeth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for stick or tree, 1 mark for chewing the end, 1 mark for rubbing the teeth.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: Brush with the intention of following the Sunnah, and to keep clean for prayer. Allah rewards good intentions. We keep the body pure and please Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for intention, 1 mark for following the Sunnah, 1 mark for keeping clean for prayer, 1 mark for reward.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: A trust from Allah that parents must look after.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for trust and 1 mark for parents' care.

19. (4 marks)
   Answer: Islam and sanity; purity; covering the awrah; facing the Qibla; the time has come.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each condition.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: A quality that describes Allah, for example Ar-Rahman, the Most Kind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning and 1 mark for a correct example.
